calls.title: Lai Mai and August Allard
calls.summary: The session concentrated on the technical support team's collaborative dynamics and troubleshooting skills regarding Growth Book's self-hosted SDK. Key misconfigurations in customer SDK setups were identified by Lai Mai, particularly concerning the incorrect API host and client key usage that hindered data flow to Google Analytics. The team discussed using an auto attributes plugin to address hardcoded user IDs and country attributes. Role-played customer interactions showcased Lai Mai's empathetic communication and effective guidance. Additionally, the support team, consisting of three members, handles an average of 13 tickets daily, aiming to enhance expertise while addressing language support gaps, particularly for Japanese-speaking customers. The meeting wrapped up with an overview of the hiring process for future team alignment.
calls.keywords: Growth Book, Technical Support, Troubleshooting, SDK, Google Analytics, A/B Testing
calls.action_items:

Share screen for troubleshooting demonstration to facilitate collaborative problem solving (02:49)
Read and analyze the provided support scenario document carefully before starting troubleshooting to understand the context and issues (03:49)

Identify and communicate to the customer the incorrect use of sample API host and client key, advising to update to customized credentials for proper tracking callback function (12:00)
Recommend adding console logs to validate that the tracking callback is executing properly to aid in debugging (15:00)
Advise the customer to use the auto attributes plugin instead of hardcoded attributes to ensure correct user ID and device type tracking (25:50)
Respond thoughtfully to role-play questions about explaining A/B testing simply and share insights on support work preferences and stress management techniques (29:51)
Ask questions about Growth Book team organization, case volumes, and language support capabilities to better understand the support environment (41:07)

**August Allard**

**Kevin Chant**

Validate troubleshooting findings and discuss plugin capabilities for automatic attribute gathering to improve support accuracy (19:11)
